title: Look Up
description: A street of towers at eye level. Drag upward and you tilt your head back: the lens widens from 70 to 140 degrees and eases from rectilinear to stereographic, so the towers lean in, bend and close into spokes around a summer sky. One 360 capture, projected exactly through r = f k tan(theta / k), developed like daylight negative film.
intent: Summer-film genre spec, idea 1 (Look Up): herb's reference 2, the worm's-eye shot of skyscrapers converging into a cumulus sky, turned into a gesture. Reference: factory/reality/herb-refs/2-wormseye-skyscrapers.png; projection family from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fisheye_lens#Mapping_function

sources.author: Andreas Mischok
sources.note: 8K HDR, sky graded offline toward the natsu targets (cobalt zenith, unclipped cloud), baked to a 2048 sRGB cubemap storing scene light / 1.35.
